mfg1-surface-mock-08-practical-q01.stem: A zinc film on iron shows white changes. What is appropriate?
options: Check coating and requirements and record location/environment
reasons: Investigation and approval are needed.
The changed substance and target are unconfirmed.
Whiteness alone establishes neither safety nor acceptance.
Appearance does not guarantee the product of corrosion.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-practical-q02.stem: Some same-lot items discolored after storage. What comparison information is appropriate?
options: Locations, drying, rinsing and storage records including unchanged items
Improvement if different light hides it
reasons: Investigate differences with conditions.
This is an unconfirmed hypothesis.
This hides the condition.
Comparison conditions differ.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-practical-q03.stem: The current field says 8 V. What is checked before correction?
options: 8 means the same current and voltage
Confirm original instrument, quantity and operator
reasons: They are different quantities.
Traceability is lost.
Letters alone do not establish facts.
What was measured remains unknown.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-practical-q04.stem: Someone claims a normal salt must be neutral and harmless. What is appropriate?
options: Separate classification from solution pH and constituent hazards
reasons: It depends on the combination.
Composition and process are unchecked.
Metal salts can present hazards.
A name alone does not establish liquid properties.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-practical-q05.stem: A portable pH electrode was replaced. What takes priority before process decisions?
reasons: Replacement still requires calibration and compatibility checks.
Internal solution is model- and procedure-specific.
This is not the current measurement.
A display alone does not guarantee accuracy.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-practical-q06.stem: In a dilute-aqueous approximation, pH changes from 6 to 4. How does hydrogen-ion concentration change?
reasons: This ignores pH change.
Two steps give 10×10.
This ignores the logarithmic relationship.
The direction is reversed.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-practical-q07.stem: Current toward you in a straight conductor is a dot viewed from the front. Which surrounding field direction follows the right-hand rule?
options: Only toward you along the conductor
A fixed direction unrelated to current
reasons: This corresponds to current away from you.
With thumb toward you, fingers curl counterclockwise.
It circles the straight conductor.
Field direction corresponds to current direction.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-practical-q08.stem: Returning a sample deformed by a bend test to a product box is proposed. What is appropriate?
options: Reshape by hand and leave unmarked
Mix it to fill a quantity shortage
Identify it as tested and use designated sample controls
reasons: Color does not establish post-test conformity.
This is unauthorized rework and lost identification.
It confuses supply quantity and sample quality.
Do not mix deformed samples with unused conforming products.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-practical-q09.stem: KYT says only pay sufficient attention. What elements make it specific?
options: Person, situation, action and checking method
reasons: KYT does not replace engineering measures.
This loses understanding and authority checks.
Make the goal executable.
This does not lead to measures.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-practical-q10.stem: Thickness fits a comparison table but not the product drawing. What is appropriate?
options: Change the drawing to the table
Identify the product-requirement mismatch and inquire
reasons: Use specified locations and decision conditions.
This is an unauthorized change.
Drawing requirements are ignored.
A general guide does not replace specifications.
